purpose: Deterministic regression contracts for TextFX creative-core orchestration; these are not a benchmark of artistic quality.

cases.invariant: Counterfactual candidate selection prefers a supplied Court score over the discovery heuristic score.
cases.expected: Highest Court-scored non-selected candidate is used as the shadow alternative.

cases.invariant: A heuristic fallback review must never be interpreted as a valid model-to-model quality comparison.
cases.expected: Counterfactual status is inconclusive and no winner is declared.

cases.invariant: Only model-based reviews may produce durable creative lessons.
cases.expected: Fallback reviews produce zero learned lessons.

cases.invariant: Counterfactual score differences are retained as evidence and do not mutate the selected candidate.
cases.expected: Comparison returns a delta and limitations without a selection action.

cases.invariant: Unsupported CreativeIR schema versions are rejected by runtime validation.
cases.expected: Validation throws for unknown schema versions.
